# Claim 100 Credits Every Day

Starting September 18, 2026 at 10:00, individual users of Qoder International can claim **100 Credits** every day in the **Qoder desktop app**. Both free users and paid individual subscribers are eligible. These Credits can be used across the Qoder International product family. **Each reward is valid for 30 days from the date you claim it, and unexpired Credits carry over to subsequent days.**

All times in this article are in Singapore Time (UTC+8).

## Promotion Details

- **Start time**: September 18, 2026 at 10:00.
- **End time**: To be announced.
- **Eligibility**: All new and existing individual users of Qoder International, including users on Free, Pro Trial, Pro, Pro+, and Ultra plans. Teams and Enterprise subscribers are not eligible.
- **Claim window**: A new claim window opens daily at 10:00 and closes just before 10:00 the following day.
- **Claim rules**: Each account can claim 100 Credits once per window. You must claim the reward manually. Missed rewards cannot be claimed later, and unclaimed amounts do not carry over to the next window.
- **Where to claim**: Exclusively in the Qoder desktop app.
- **Reward validity**: Each reward is valid for 30 days from the date you claim it. Any unused portion expires automatically. Each reward has its own expiration date; claiming a new reward does not extend the validity of earlier rewards.

## Where You Can Use the Credits

After claiming your reward, sign in with the same account to use the Credits in the following Qoder International products:

- Qoder
- Qoder IDE
- Qoder JetBrains plugin
- Qoder CLI
- QoderWake
- Qoder Cloud Agents
- Qoder Mobile
- Qoder web app

Claiming promotional Credits does not change your subscription tier or feature access. Features remain subject to your current plan.

## How to Claim and Use Your Credits

1. Open **Qoder** and create or sign in to an individual account.
2. During the claim window, open the promotion through the **Usage panel → gift icon** in the lower-left corner of the app.
3. Claim the **100 Credits** available for the current window. The reward will be added to your account's Add-on Credits.
4. Sign in with the same account to use these Credits in the products listed above.

## How to Check Your Balance and Usage

Sign in to the [Qoder website](https://qoder.com), click your avatar in the upper-right corner, and go to **Settings > Usage**. Here you can view your current plan, available balances, and usage details for each type of Credits.

This reward is added to **Add-on Credits**. Add-on Credits include Credits obtained through purchases or promotions and are for personal use only.

## Credit Deduction Rules

Promotional Credits follow the existing deduction rules: **Credits that expire soonest are used first**. If your plan Credits expire sooner, they are used first; if your Add-on Credits expire sooner, those are used first. When expiration times are the same, plan Credits are used before Add-on Credits.

For more information, see the [Credits documentation](/Credits).

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Will I receive the reward automatically when I sign in?

No. You must open the promotion in Qoder during the claim window and claim the reward manually.

### Can I claim a reward after missing its claim window?

No. Each claim window runs from 10:00 until just before 10:00 the following day. Once a window closes, its reward can no longer be claimed. When the next window opens, you can claim a new reward of 100 Credits.

### Can I claim the reward in other products?

Rewards can only be claimed in the Qoder desktop app. Once claimed, the Credits can be used in the products listed under “Where You Can Use the Credits.”
